title: Honor and Conquest
text:
PvP progression arrives: a battleground, two currencies and two sets of PvP gear.

✨ Emberclash Fields, a new battleground: the Ember Legion and the Frost Vanguard fight over the Sunfall Shrine, the Ashen Forge and Thornfield Mill. Stand on a point to capture it; holding one, two or all three scores 1, 2 or 4 points a second, and the first team to 400 wins. It runs with as few as one player a side. Speak to Battlemaster Ysolde in Hearthmere (level 10+); type -o or click Leave to go home
✨ Honor: earn 1 for every player you defeat in the arena or the battleground, 2 for capturing a point, 25 for winning a battle and 10 for losing one
✨ Conquest: earn 3 for every kill in the Bloodsand Arena, and 5 more on a three-kill streak
✨ The Emberguard set (Honor, from Battlemaster Ysolde) and the Ashen Champion set (Conquest, from Varro the Bloodsworn): a weapon, armour and a trinket for every class, requiring level 20. Emberguard is the second-strongest gear in Emberfall and Ashen Champion the strongest, and every piece adds PvP Toughness (less damage taken from players) and PvP Damage
✨ Your Honor and Conquest are shown in your bags. Three new achievements: Battle-Tested, Honor Bound and Champion of the Sands
